newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted softer on the U.S. dollar but closed on Wednesday firmer against other hard units after a fairly quiet interbank session.
"It was very quiet today and the dollar was confined to a 0.25 cent movement (against the U.S. dollar)," commented one foreign exchange dealer.
"Being a short market day everyone just wanted to stay square," he added.
The local unit finished the day at 11.3850/3950 against the U.S. dollar from Tuesday's 11.3825/3925 but was quoted firmer versus pound sterling at 19.2115/2880 compared to 19.2360/2590.
It was at 6.4650/4920 from 6.4870/4940 against the mark and at 2.5005/5105 against the rand, a slight gain over 2.5020/5060 the previous day.
